name: CivEconomy
detailed_description:
"Less pretty, more witty. The civilization economics simulator for players who think."

Step into the role of a legendary ruler and guide your civilization from humble settlement to mighty empire in CivEconomy Chronicles of Civilization, a deep strategy game that puts economic mastery and family dynasties at the heart of empire building.

Rule Through Family Legacy Your civilization isn't just buildings and armies - it's the noble families who shape its destiny. Navigate complex family politics as the Ironhand blacksmiths forge your military might, the Goldweaver merchants control your trade routes, and the Brightflame scholars unlock new technologies. Each family has unique abilities, ambitions, and rivalries that directly impact your empire's growth.

Master Economic Warfare Every decision has economic consequences in this intricate simulation where supply chains matter as much as battle tactics. Copper shortages can cripple your bronze industry, while a successful trade agreement might fund your next military campaign. Balance resource allocation, manage market volatility, and outmaneuver rival civilizations through economic strategy as much as military might.

Adaptive Interface Built For You Whether you prefer detailed analysis on large screens or streamlined decision-making on smaller displays, CivEconomy adapts to your setup. Choose from multiple visual themes and resolution modes that transform the interface to match your preferences, ensuring you always have the perfect view of your growing empire.

Dynamic Crisis Management Face civilization-threatening challenges that test your leadership skills. When the copper mines run dry, will you negotiate expensive trade deals or risk dangerous exploration missions? Every crisis offers multiple solutions with far-reaching consequences that ripple through your economy, family relationships, and international standing.

Deep Strategic Gameplay Research advanced technologies through your scholar families, forge diplomatic alliances that reshape regional power, and build trade networks that span continents. Every turn presents meaningful choices where family loyalty, economic necessity, and strategic opportunity intersect.

Key Features

  • Family-based civilization management with unique dynasties

  • Complex economic simulation with realistic supply chains

  • Adaptive interface supporting multiple themes and resolutions

  • Crisis management system with branching consequences

  • Deep research trees unlocked through family expertise

  • Diplomatic system affecting trade and military options

  • Customizable civilization identity with flag designer

  • Turn-based strategy with meaningful long-term decisions

Create your legacy. Build your empire. Master the art of civilization.

short_description: CivEconomy is an economic civilization simulator where you guide your kingdom from stone age to industrial era. Balance resource production, taxation, and market dynamics while managing seasonal challenges and social classes. Will your decisions create an empire that stands the test of time?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 or newer
  • Processor: Dual-core processor (Intel Core i3 or equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9 compatible graphics card
  • Storage: 700 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 (High Sierra) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent (or Apple Silicon with Rosetta 2)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU
  • Storage: 700 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 or equivalent modern distribution
  • Processor: Dual-core processor (Intel Core i3 or equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: X11 with compatible window manager
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
